name: Hydroponics rack, three tiers
brief: MK-076 Hydroponics rack. Round 2, matched to the pick: a chunky framed grow cabinet with an open front, three tiers (lettuce at Abbie's height, herbs, then tomato vines spilling over), pink grow light strips above each tier, an orange status window on the side and a water line. Diegetic: plants droop and the pink light flickers when water or power is low; ripe tomatoes mean harvest time.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
